verdict.rationale: Bugbot documents on-demand triggering by commenting `cursor review` or `bugbot run` on any PR, alongside automatic reviews on PR updates. The pack has no evidence of skipping drafts or filtering by branch or label. A community user who disabled automatic reviews had to fall back on their own GitHub Action, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented draft-PR skipping, branch-based filtering, label-based triggering or filtering, documented toggle for disabling automatic runs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I control when reviews run — skip drafts, trigger on demand, filter by branch or label — so the bot shows up only when wanted

citations.quote: Manual trigger by commenting `cursor review` or `bugbot run` on any PR
When enabled, Bugbot automatically runs AI code review in the background on new PRs.
